name: Ezra
tagline: Turns a sermon into small-group and full teaching notes in Bahasa
description: Takes a sermon or a summary of one and produces two markdown documents from it in Bahasa Indonesia: a shorter version for sharing in a small group, and a fuller teaching set laid out for structured study. It will also answer questions about the text itself.
author: lapaksquare
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
